_comment: sim-robust-movegroup-double-death-v1 bounded GPU proof config for the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Purpose: prove the TWO recovery gaps the canonical capstone coldwin4 exposed (run ~/datasets/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1/mission/coldwin4, head 5611965/PR #240, config mission-runtime-capstone238.json, SIM_GAP=30) now recover a move_group death -- or TWO -- during collect WITHOUT losing the carton from the planning scene (gap 1) and WITHOUT a stale trajectory_host goal rejecting the reseeded resend (gap 2). This EXTENDS the single-death recovery stack (PR #224 respawn re-sync, #227 mid-op/second-death, #228 sim-clock deadlines, #229 first-goal race, #234 crash re-send): those recover MOST deaths; coldwin4 died on the two remaining gaps. GAP 1 (op 1/6): MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY engaged but 're-attach of restock_carried_unit FAILED after respawn' -- PAYLOAD_SYNC_DIAG showed held=True s_contact=True age=0.067 scene_ready=True attach_ready=True, yet the freshly respawned move_group REJECTED the attach goal (gate=attach_goal_rejected; it had not finished re-initialising), and the single-shot recovery then planned CARTON-LESS. GAP 2 (op 2/6): a mid-EXECUTION respawn+reseed (MOVE_GROUP_RESPAWN_RESEED) left the pre-crash FollowJointTrajectory goal LIVE on the executor -> the reseeded resend was rejected 'TRAJ_HOST_GOAL_REJECT a previous goal is still executing (active=True)' -> PORT_FAULT_ESTOP 'execution failed' -> the stale goal tracking-faulted at 1.314 rad -> e-stop. Fix: gap 1 retries the attach bounded on the SIM clock (never resend carton-less; fail by name if it never succeeds); gap 2 force-clears the crash-abandoned live goal via /arm_controller/abort_active before resending (PR #229's op-start reset never clears a LIVE goal).
_how_to_run: A COLLECT-ONLY run under the FULL capstone238 keys. Starting from the coldwin4 run config (~/datasets/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1/mission/mission-runtime-capstone238.json; do NOT edit that file -- copy it): keep every capstone key (transfer_mode live_pose, the masked_depth arm feed, the station keys, RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S=30) and ADD --stop-after collect so the run ends at the end of the collect op (the STOW is the last collect move), not at couple -- the place-on-cart / couple blockers owned by other lanes are never entered. Invoke scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, --heavy-threshold-mb 2500 for the always-on whispr (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB VRAM -- never touch it), never --force, never the hard Blender gate, one GPU run at a time. Honest collect (RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH unset) reproduces the coldwin4 live_pose stress most faithfully; RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1 is a faster, more deterministic carry+stow for a quicker proof. Leave RESTOCK_REATTACH_SIM_BUDGET_S at its default (30 sim-s).
_inject_a_double_move_group_kill: A move_group SIGABRT is intermittent and cannot be forced from inside the mission (the mission process does NOT own the move_group pid -- launch.py does), so NO repo code signals it: the DOUBLE injection is an integration-lane step the lane owns because it owns the single-GPU boot (at that moment only this lane's move_group is planning). Reproduce coldwin4's two deaths deterministically with TWO kills in one collect op: (1) MID-PLAN -- during an EARLY collect move while it is PLANNING (the controller prints the phase + the port logs a plan_accept/plan_result for that move, e.g. approach or the carton-loaded lift), send `kill -ABRT $(pgrep -f move_group)` (confirm a single pid first; the guard pins ROS_DOMAIN_ID so only this lane's node is up). This exercises GAP 1: move_group respawns (launch respawn=True, respawn_delay=3.0) with a FRESH scene, and the carton (already welded/attached) must be re-attached before the resend. (2) MID-EXECUTION -- after the carton is attached, during a LATER collect move while the arm is EXECUTING a trajectory (the trajectory_host is streaming TRAJ_HOST feedback for a live FollowJointTrajectory goal), send a SECOND `kill -ABRT $(pgrep -f move_group)`. This exercises GAP 2: the reseeded resend must force-clear the crash-abandoned live goal (abort_active) so it is accepted. Space the two kills so each respawn completes before the next kill (watch for the respawn 'process ... move_group' re-advertise between them).
_expected_pass: PASS for THIS lane when BOTH gaps recover and the collect reaches the post-release STOW / transport_ready: action=collect status=succeeded transport_ready=True, with NO terminal 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED ... reason="host emergency stop"' and NO 'arm command heartbeat lost' for the injected deaths. For the MID-PLAN kill (gap 1), host-stack.log must show, in order: 'process has died ... move_group ... exit code -6' -> MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY (hold/awaiting-respawn or the plan sim/wall-deadline re-send) -> the carton re-attach retried and ACCEPTED ('re-attached restock_carried_unit to the respawned move_group planning scene before resend'; it may be preceded by one or more 'not yet acknowledged ... will retry bounded on the sim clock' lines as the respawned planner finishes init) -> 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY resending plan goal after respawn' -> the move completes. The resend must NEVER plan carton-less (there must be NO 'will plan WITHOUT it'; that pre-fix string is removed). For the MID-EXECUTION kill (gap 2): a 'TRAJ_HOST_ABORT_ACTIVE ...' line (the force-clear of the crash-abandoned live goal) BEFORE the reseeded resend's new goal is accepted, and NO repeated 'TRAJ_HOST_GOAL_REJECT a previous goal is still executing' / no 1.314-rad tracking fault from a stale goal. The bounded-escalation outcomes are also an ACCEPTABLE PASS of this deliverable when move_group genuinely never respawns: 'move_group did not respawn within 45s', or the gap-1 'carton could not be re-attached ... failing fast rather than planning without the carton', or the gap-2/PR228 'the move_group planner crashed or hung ... failing fast' -- a NAMED fast fail, never a bare e-stop or an opaque phase timeout. The move_group heap crash itself (exit -6, 'malloc(): unaligned tcache chunk detected' / 'malloc_consolidate') is upstream MoveIt/cuMotion and is not fixable in the host.
_what_to_grep: grep -nE 'exit code -6|process has died .*move_group' host-stack.log            # the two SIGABRT deaths
grep -n 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY' host-stack.log                                 # recovery fired, in order
grep -n 're-attached restock_carried_unit' host-stack.log                       # GAP 1: the carton was restored to the respawned scene
grep -nE 'not yet acknowledged|NEVER SUCCEEDED' host-stack.log                  # GAP 1: the bounded sim-clock re-attach retry (and its named fail, if any)
grep -n 'will plan WITHOUT it' host-stack.log                                   # MUST be ABSENT (the pre-fix carton-less resend is removed)
grep -n 'TRAJ_HOST_ABORT_ACTIVE' host-stack.log                                 # GAP 2: the crash-abandoned live goal was force-cleared before the resend
grep -n 'TRAJ_HOST_GOAL_REJECT a previous goal is still executing' host-stack.log # GAP 2: MUST NOT persist after the abort (would mean the resend was rejected)
grep -nE 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED .* host emergency stop|arm command heartbeat lost' <mission-console>.log  # MUST be ABSENT for the injected deaths (the coldwin4 failure)
_no_config_keys: This proof needs NO mission runtime-config key -- both fixes live in scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_adapter.py (_begin_post_respawn_recovery / _step_reattach / _publish_abort_active) and scripts/twin/restock/trajectory_host.py (abort_active_signal + the execute-loop abort path) and are always-on + self-disabling: the re-attach only runs on a crash-retry resend with a held carton, and abort_active is only published on a crash-retry resend, so a live-server rejection and the WHOLE no-crash path are byte-identical. Combine with movegroup-estop-retry-collect-fragment.json (PR-level raise-path recovery) and movegroup-respawn-collect-fragment.json (PR #224 mid-carry re-attach) if desired; all are orthogonal.

_suggested_env.RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH: UNSET for the faithful honest/live_pose carry (coldwin4), or 1 for a faster deterministic carry+stow
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_REATTACH_SIM_BUDGET_S: optional (default 30) -- the SIM-clock budget for the post-respawn carton re-attach retry before the gap-1 named fast fail; leave default (well under the 120-sim-s collect phase timeout)
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY_OP_MAX: optional (default 6) -- the TOTAL per-op crash-retry cap; two injected deaths in one collect op use 2, well within it; leave default
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_SENSOR_STREAM_WALL_BACKSTOP_S: keep the sim value (180) so a long respawn + re-attach hold does not trip the /sensors wall backstop before recovery completes
